scope: All files tracked at the source commit, including ignored tracked output and hidden directories; text plus PDF extraction, gzip decompression and binary printable strings. Case-insensitive substring searches; identifiers and tests are counted, not treated as public claims.
limitations: Image-only text not exhaustively OCR-searched: local Vision attempt blocked by unaccepted Xcode license; license not changed. Screenshot artifacts classified as historical/internal, not current copy.
Database dump scanned for printable strings only, not restored. No private historical snippets are exported.
Term matches overlap and include identifiers. Zero exact phrase matches do not establish the absence of synonymous claims.
